login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to your Ponctua workspace.

accounts.title: Connected accounts
accounts.notConfigured: Instagram connection is not configured on this server yet.
accounts.connectError: Could not start the Instagram connection.

result.cancelled: Connection cancelled: no account was added.
result.invalid_state: The connection expired or is not valid. Please start again.
result.no_account: No Instagram professional account was shared with the app.
result.failed: The Instagram connection failed. Please try again.

auth.name: Name
auth.passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters. A passphrase is easier to remember.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, for example name@agency.ca.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, for example name@agency.ca.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {{count}} characters long.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.emailNotVerified: Your address is not confirmed yet. We just sent you a new link: open it to activate your account.
errors.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.invalidCode: Incorrect code. Check the time on your phone and try again.
errors.codeExpired: The check has expired or there were too many attempts. Sign in again with your password.
errors.sessionNotFresh: For security, adding a passkey needs a recent sign-in. Sign in again, then try once more.
errors.userVerificationRequired: Your device must verify it is you (PIN, fingerprint or face). Turn on a screen lock on the device, then try again.
errors.passkeyFailed: The passkey could not be verified. Try again or use your password.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.description: Create your account, then your organization to invite your team.

checkEmail.title: Check your inbox
checkEmail.body: If this address can be used, a confirmation link was just sent to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account: it is valid for 24 hours.
checkEmail.help: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or sign in to get a new link.

organizations.title: Choose an organization
organizations.description: You belong to several organizations. Choose the one to work in.

new.title: Create your organization
new.description: An organization brings together your team and the clients you manage. You will be its owner.
new.nameHint: For example, the name of your agency.
new.nameInvalid: The name must be between 2 and 120 characters.
new.error: Could not create the organization. Try again.

errors.page: The page could not be loaded.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.description: Enter the address of your account: we will send you a link to choose a new password.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link was just sent. It is valid for 1 hour.
sent.help: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, then try again.

resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.description: Choose your new password. Every open session will be signed out.

done.title: Password changed
done.body: Your password was changed and every session was signed out. Sign in with the new one.

invalid.title: Invalid or expired link
invalid.body: This reset link no longer works: it may have been used already or be older than 1 hour.

done.title: Address confirmed
done.body: Your email address is confirmed and you are signed in.

invalid.title: Invalid or expired link
invalid.body: This confirmation link no longer works. Sign in: a new link will be sent to you.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing the password signs out your other sessions; a confirmation email is sent to you.
password.done: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: On top of the password, a 6-digit code from your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…) is asked at sign-in.
twoFactor.disabledNotice: Two-factor authentication is off. An email was sent to you.

confirm.disable: Confirm your password to turn off two-factor authentication. Your account will be protected by the password only.
confirm.regenerate: Confirm your password. The old backup codes will stop working.

setup.step2: Scan the QR code, or type the key below.
setup.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app.
setup.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
setup.manualKey: Key to type if you cannot scan:

backupCodes.explain: Keep these {{count}} backup codes somewhere safe: each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.

signIn.title: Two-step verification
signIn.description: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.
signIn.backupDescription: Enter one of your backup codes (format XXXXX-XXXXX).

errors.backupFormat: A backup code looks like XXXXX-XXXXX.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: A passkey signs you in with your device (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, phone), with no password or code. It counts as two-factor authentication.
passkeys.nameHint: To recognize it later, for example “MacBook” or “Phone”.
passkeys.added: Passkey added. A confirmation email was sent to you.
passkeys.removed: Passkey removed. A confirmation email was sent to you.
